executive_summary: In highlight coverage, our analysis of the 2026 FIFA World Cup prediction markets generating $20B in onchain volume dominated earned media across TradingView, BeInCrypto, incrypted, and CoinMarketCap, establishing us as the authoritative source on prediction market scale. Our Coldcard wallet exploit research—identifying $30M stolen in minutes targeting high-value addresses—was picked up by CryptoRank and Bitcoin World, while our stablecoin infrastructure projection ($1.5 quadrillion annual processing by 2035) anchored institutional narratives in CoinMarketCap. Our partnership with Polymarket on insider trading detection tools and compliance research on hybrid blockchains expanded our positioning into market integrity and institutional demand. In crypto news, the $4B Iranian sanctions evasion network exposed by Reuters represents escalating illicit finance complexity that validates our enforcement positioning; Tether's $1.5B Q2 profit with halving reserves signals stablecoin infrastructure maturation; and the Coldcard exploit's ripple effects—pushing self-custody skepticism toward ETF adoption—reshape institutional custody narratives across CoinDesk. In competitor news, Elliptic secured marquee wins with Sei, HashKey, and a $3.1M compliance efficiency deal, positioning aggressively on VASP infrastructure; Arkham pivoted exchange to full decentralization while capitalizing on Lazarus Group tracking; and Merkle Science continued quiet positioning on privacy-compliant blockchain monitoring.

market_landscape.title: Institutional Crypto Infrastructure Maturing
market_landscape.body: Prediction market scale ($20B World Cup volume), stablecoin processing projections ($1.5 quadrillion by 2035), and tokenized stock trading surge (288% in July) signal crypto infrastructure crossing into systemic-scale adoption. Coldcard exploit paradoxically accelerates this by pushing institutional custody into regulated ETF and custodian models, reducing self-custody risk.

market_landscape.title: Regulatory Enforcement Scaling Rapidly
market_landscape.body: Iran sanctions evasion ($4B network), EU Russia sanctions intensification, and CLARITY Act debate show regulators moving from theoretical framework to active prosecution infrastructure. Compliance automation and blockchain forensics transition from optional to regulatory mandate across geographies.

market_landscape.title: AI-Fraud Arms Race Intensifying
market_landscape.body: Solana Foundation warns AI-driven scams are outpacing defenses; $420K law enforcement impersonation scam demonstrates social engineering sophistication. Compliance teams face asymmetric threat from AI-enhanced fraud requiring real-time pattern detection and behavioral anomaly systems.
